method: Whole twenty manually reviewed test declarations plus actual connected fixtures/callees; metadata-only packaging uses explicit line spans. No source parser/scanner/helper execution. Historical current hash preserved alongside canonical drift.

classification_definitions.integration: Core observable assertion traverses genuine project service/protocol/process/store or production file effect/readback boundary.
classification_definitions.unit: Core assertion is local predicate/vector/concurrency guard or fake effect; incidental file setup/writes do not promote it.
classification_definitions.mixed: Distinct local-only and genuine boundary assertion blocks coexist; retain local obligations explicitly.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Insufficient source/mapping evidence for a category; separate from runtime UNKNOWN.

assertion_evidence.text:
renewedCert, renewedKey, renewed := ca.leaf(t, "gru-1-ctl-1", "127.0.0.1", time.Now().Add(2*time.Hour))
	installTLS(t, files, renewedCert, renewedKey, ca)
	reloading.mu.Lock()
	reloading.loading = true
	reloading.mu.Unlock()
	if serial := reloading.material().certificate.Leaf.SerialNumber; serial.Cmp(first) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a handshake during a reload got serial %v, want the current %v", serial, first)
	}
	reloading.mu.Lock()
	reloading.loading = false
	reloading.mu.Unlock()
	if serial := reloading.material().certificate.Leaf.SerialNumber; serial.Cmp(renewed) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("after the reload: serial %v, want %v", serial, renewed)
	}

qualification_limits: No actual blocked file read or TLS handshake is induced; the in-flight condition is manually injected under the mutex.

roots.reason: The accepts closure performs actual TLS TCP connect and one-byte echo against production ServerConfig. It asserts rejection/acceptance while real bundle files gain the next CA, leaf moves, and old CA is dropped. Client trust and presented client credentials are independently selected for each connection.

assertion_evidence.text:
address := serveEcho(t, reloading.ServerConfig())
	oldClient, nextClient := old.client(t), next.client(t)
	accepts := func(step string, roots []testCA, certificate tls.Certificate, want bool) {
		t.Helper()
		conn, _, err := dial(address, clientConfig(roots, certificate))
		if conn != nil {
			conn.Close()
		}
		if (err == nil) != want {
			t.Fatalf("%s: accepted %v, want %v (%v)", step, err == nil, want, err)
		}
	}
	accepts("before the rollover, a new-CA client", []testCA{old, next}, nextClient, false)

	installTLS(t, files, certPEM, keyPEM, old, next)
	accepts("both trusted, an old-CA client", []testCA{old}, oldClient, true)
	accepts("both trusted, a new-CA client", []testCA{old}, nextClient, true)

	nextCert, nextKey, _ := next.leaf(t, "gru-1-ctl-1", "127.0.0.1", time.Now().Add(time.Hour))
	installTLS(t, files, nextCert, nextKey, old, next)
	accepts("new leaf, a peer that trusts only the new CA", []testCA{next}, nextClient, true)

	installTLS(t, files, nextCert, nextKey, next)
	accepts("old CA dropped, an old-CA client", []testCA{old, next}, oldClient, false)
	accepts("old CA dropped, a new-CA client", []testCA{next}, nextClient, true)

qualification_limits: Local TLS fixture clients only; no NATS authentication, cloud CA issuance or cluster rollout is qualified.

tls_fixture.summary: Fixture-only CA/leaf generation and atomic file installation; newCheckingTLS sets checkEvery=0; actual TLS echo helpers use tcp TLS listener, handshake and one-byte roundtrip.

tls_reload.summary: Production loads file bytes and verifies before replacing current; configured callbacks expose material to actual TLS handshakes.

citations.text:
func (r *ReloadingTLS) material() tlsMaterial {
	r.mu.Lock()
	current := r.current
	if r.loading || time.Since(r.checkedAt) < r.checkEvery {
		r.mu.Unlock()
		return current
	}
	r.loading, r.checkedAt = true, time.Now()
	r.mu.Unlock()
	read, err := readTLSFiles(r.files)
	defer clear(read.key)
	stamp := read.stamp()
	r.mu.Lock()
	unchanged := err == nil && stamp == r.stamp || stamp == r.rejected && time.Since(r.rejectedAt) < time.Minute
	r.mu.Unlock()
	var material tlsMaterial
	if !unchanged && err == nil {
		material, err = r.verified(read, current.roots)
	}
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	r.loading = false
	if unchanged {
		return r.current
	}
	if err != nil {
		r.rejected, r.rejectedAt = stamp, time.Now()
		slog.Warn("NATS TLS reload rejected; keeping the last good certificate", "tls", r.role, "error", err)
		return r.current
	}
	r.stamp, r.current = stamp, material
	slog.Info("NATS TLS reloaded", "tls", r.role, "not_after", material.certificate.Leaf.NotAfter)
	return material
}

tls_validation.summary: Leaf validity, usages and chain predicates plus the actual owner-only private-file reader.

unavailable_fixture.summary: Fixtures construct credentials and Config, never start a broker. productionTestUser returns an external-client config. freeClientPort closes its listener before caller uses the port.

unavailable_start.summary: Start calls config validation first, then external clientOptions and actual nats.Connect; network failure wrapped with unavailable. Embedded-server branch is not selected in this root.

nats_client.summary: Credentials and TLS material are actual files; custom TLS-first dialer calls tls.DialWithDialer. Local invalid cell/replicas are pre-I/O.

agent_fixture.summary: Fixture loads checked-in image pin and signs local envelopes; workerFixture adds an isolated private directory. None of these helpers downloads or executes anything.

agent_verify.summary: All verification is local decode/signature/scope/identity/pin/enrollment predicates; no effect or spool is entered by Verify.

agent_relay.summary: Relay does actual file staging, sync, validation and final publication; injected fetch writes fixture bytes only.

binary_verifier.summary: VerifyBinary opens/stat-bounds staged file before ELF and digest comparison; short untrusted bytes fail the 64-byte lower bound.

agent_spool.summary: Held-directory openat filesystem operations, no-follow/nonblocking reads, sync and rename implement real persistent outputs. Result/status files are diagnostic mode0644; ledger mode0600.

agent_worker.summary: applyStep verifies/guards before journaling authority, runs injected effect, persists result then diagnostic copy. Private ledger has direct no-follow bounded readback. Scope is durable bookkeeping, not real NetBird installation.

agent_missing.summary: OS PATH lookup and lstat only; no exec.Command or actual client invocation.

qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION for every root; no build/test/runtime receipts reviewed or execution performed.
Canonical Git blobs only; all baseline/current raw declarations retain exact original identity, assertions and safety obligations.
Actual local file/TLS/socket boundaries do not establish live NetBird/OCI/cloud behavior, cluster availability or installation success.

All injected perform/fetch callbacks and test-only immediate TLS reload cadence are explicit. No privileged binary execution, signing, cryptographic test execution, network download or cloud request occurred.
No repository/source/ledger mutation, deletion, retirement, global count promotion or completion credit. Independent peer acceptance and separate ledger promotion remain required.

findings.detail: Historical survival row retains the baseline declaration hash; actual canonical declaration replaces old Lab setup with production TLS/JWT external-client fixtures and removes Lab fields from guard cases. Original/current full text, exact bounds and hashes are preserved; no remapping or retirement credit.
The supplied untrusted executable fixture is below64 bytes; production rejects file size before ELF/digest comparison. Do not claim digest mismatch coverage.
old-transaction is noncanonical ULID and fails format validation; this does not prove replay rejection for an old valid transaction.

route reconstructs PeerConfig each time. RootCAs snapshots current material before subsequent callbacks read new files. This root only asserts its exact one-attempt sequence and newly constructed reloader, not repeated use of one fixed dialer config.
